import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Top 10 dog breeds in Zurich
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(breed_counts.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog distribution by district
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
district_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(district_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(district_counts.values, labels=district_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors,
                                   textprops={'fontsize': 8})
ax2.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Dog age distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
age_order = df['AlterVHundLang'].dropna().unique()
age_order = sorted(age_order, key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else 0)
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reindex(age_order)
ax3.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Dog Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Dog gender distribution
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors_gender = ['#FF9999', '#66B2FF', '#99FF99']
wedges2, texts2, autotexts2 = ax4.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, 
                                      autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_gender[:len(gender_counts)])
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Owner age distribution
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
owner_age_counts = df['AlterV10Lang'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax5.bar(range(len(owner_age_counts)), owner_age_counts.values, color='lightcoral', edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(owner_age_counts)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(owner_age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax5.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Owners', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Dog Owner Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Dogs per year trend
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
year_counts = df['StichtagDatJahr'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax6.plot(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=6, color='darkgreen')
ax6.fill_between(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='lightgreen')
ax6.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs Registered', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Dog Registrations Over Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 7. Top dog colors
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
color_counts = df['HundefarbeText'].value_counts().head(8)
bars7 = ax7.bar(range(len(color_counts)), color_counts.values, color=['#8B4513', '#D2691E', '#F4A460', 
                                                                      '#DEB887', '#A0522D', '#CD853F', 
                                                                      '#D2B48C', '#BC8F8F'])
ax7.set_xticks(range(len(color_counts)))
ax7.set_xticklabels(color_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax7.set_xlabel('Dog Color', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Most Common Dog Colors', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 8. Mixed vs pure breed distribution
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
mixed_breed = df['Rasse2Text'].notna().sum()
pure_breed = len(df) - mixed_breed
breed_types = ['Pure Breed', 'Mixed Breed']
breed_counts_vals = [pure_breed, mixed_breed]
colors_breed = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
ax8.bar(breed_types, breed_counts_vals, color=colors_breed, edgecolor='black')
ax8.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Pure vs Mixed Breed Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')
for i, v in enumerate(breed_counts_vals):
    ax8.text(i, v + 500, str(v), ha='center', fontsize=10)

# 9. Owner gender distribution
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
owner_gender_counts = df['SexLang'].value_counts()
colors_owner = ['#FF9999', '#66B2FF']
wedges3, texts3, autotexts3 = ax9.pie(owner_gender_counts.values, labels=owner_gender_counts.index, 
                                      autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_owner)
ax9.set_title('Dog Owner Gender Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Zurich Dog Registration Analysis\nComprehensive Overview of Canine Population', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
